observations: Single close-up photo of a used engine block with air intake housing, hoses, and a wiring connector.
No visible brand logo, model stamp, VIN, or part number readable in the image.
A watermark 'Famous Auto Parts' is visible but this is the seller's own branding, not the engine's identity.
Surface shows normal grime/oil staining consistent with a used engine; no visible cracks or leaks are discernible from this single angle.

claims.evidence: Marketing language, no photo evidence possible.
No import documents, plate, or shipping label shown in photo.
No test video, gauge reading, or running clip provided.
No odometer, mileage sticker, or service record shown.
No photo of seals, bolts, or gasket condition to confirm untouched state.

risks.risk: Engine make/model is unknown, and price varies hugely by make (from small sedan engines to large V6/V8 or turbo units).
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine block casting number, valve cover logo, or VIN/engine code tag.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, since worst-case and best-case comparables differ by over 10x.

risks.risk: Claimed 'tested and working' and 'no knock' cannot be confirmed remotely.
risks.proof: Video of engine running/idling with sound audible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working/unverified mechanical condition.

risks.risk: Claimed low mileage and 'never opened' cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo of mileage sticker, import papers, or untouched factory seals/bolts.

risks.risk: Origin claim (Belgium tokunbo) unverifiable, affects trust in genuineness and import duty/quality assumptions.
risks.proof: Photo of shipping/import documentation or customs tag.
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified origin, standard used-engine risk applies.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine block casting number, valve cover text, or any VIN/engine code tag to identify make and model.
Wide shot showing the whole engine from multiple angles (front, side, back) to assess completeness and condition.
Video of the engine running/idling with audible sound to support 'tested and working, no knock' claim.
Photo of mileage sticker or import/customs paperwork to support 'low mileage' and 'Tokunbo direct from Belgium' claims.
response.reason: The single photo shows only a generic engine close-up with no readable brand, model, or identifying marks, and the price of used engines varies by more than 10x depending on make/model, so no worst-case price can be assigned without identification.
